name: free-live-personal-tv
description: Day-1 self-hosted MVP for mobile/web instant capture and streaming

scripts.android:init: npm run cap:config && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run cap:config && npm run android:localprops && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
